sources.snippet: Models /Gemma 4 E2B Gemma 4 E2B — Ultra-Lightweight Local AI Gemma 4 E2B packs 2.1 billion parameters into the smallest footprint in the Gemma 4 family. Text-only, 8K context, and capable of running entirely on CPU — making it the go-to model for edge devices, embedded systems, and ultra-low-latency applications.

sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-E2B-it is an instruction-tuned multimodal model with 2.3 billion effective parameters (5.1B with embeddings) built by google. The model processes text, images, and audio inputs to generate text outputs using a hybrid attention mechanism that combines local sliding window attention (512 tokens) with full global attention.
